basics.name: Petri Kivistö
basics.label: Principal Software Developer and Architect, Partner
basics.summary:
Petri enjoys projects where the focus is on finding solutions efficiently through collaboration.

He is solution-oriented, works efficiently and is flexible in teamwork.

With extensive experience and a genuine passion for his work, Petri brings speed, clarity, and calm confidence to problem-solving.

He is particularly interested in how agentic development is reshaping ways of working—accelerating development and opening up new, meaningful ways to create results and build software.
basics.x-tagline: Building innovative, high-quality software that tackles real problems — efficient, scalable and dependable, and always aiming to go beyond what the project expected.

x-strengths.title: Backend development, Java ecosystem
x-strengths.description: Petri has an impressive 19 years of experience in Java development and architecture design.

x-strengths.title: Database architecture and development
x-strengths.description: Petri has more than 20 years of experience in database architecture and development including both relational and document databases.

x-strengths.title: Actively curious attitude
x-strengths.description: Petri does not wait for problems to pile up; instead, he proactively addresses them and drives projects forward with determination. As an experienced developer, Petri actively shares his expertise and supports his team members.

x-keyRoles.title: Lead developer
x-keyRoles.description: As a lead developer, Petri has overseen the whole project from technology selections to implementation and documentation.

x-keyRoles.title: Senior backend developer
x-keyRoles.description: Petri has experience in multiple projects in the role of senior backend developer with responsibilities including e.g. architectural design, development and team leading.

x-keySkills.title: AI development tools
x-keySkills.description: In the latest customer projects, it has been possible to utilize agentic development or AI assisting development tools to speed up the development process. Petri has had good experience with these tools and looks forward to seeing how much more they will affect his work in the future.

x-keySkills.title: LLM development as a hobby
x-keySkills.description: As a hobby, Petri developed a language model-based AI bot over 10 years ago and has been maintaining it and following its evolution over the years as the database used has expanded constantly.

basics.x-hobbies: Develops and maintains a language model-based chatbot as a hobby.

projects.name: Web admin tool development
projects.x-note: The source gives only the client name and technologies; no role or dates. The role is inferred from the description.
projects.description: Extended the web admin tool with new user, sample, and product management features, bulk Excel exports, a unified design refresh, infinite-scroll pagination, and TOTP 2FA for admins. Backed by Lambda + GraphQL changes for new fields and batch operations.

projects.name: Game content backend platform
projects.description:
Backend platform for managing downloadable game content across the client's gaming platform. In short: it's a versioned, schema-validated game content pipeline — from authoring through validation and packaging to delivery (Kafka + KV).

The development team used strongly AI assisted and agentic development methods – mainly with Claude Code.

projects.name: Digital service platform microservice refactoring
projects.description: The client's digital service platform is a modern platform where pharmacies, hospitals, health stores, pharmaceutical and health product companies, and other healthcare operators can connect in a new way. Petri's task was to refactor deprecated microservices from the Lagom framework into a system powered by Spring Boot and the Axon framework.

projects.name: Large-scale billing system
projects.description: The team developed a large-scale billing system for public hospitals and health care clinics serving over a million customers in a large Finnish healthcare region. The system gathers customer visit data as HL7 FHIR messages and processes the data in those messages into billable format that is then divided to the responsible payees for billing. Event based microservice architecture where messages are processed through messaging queues. Petri's role included development work and supporting architects in architectural design as part of the scrum team.

projects.name: Billing system rewrite
projects.x-note: The project list gives 2019-2020, the highlight slide 2018-2020; the project list dates are used. The highlight slide lists different technologies (the same list as the pharmaceutical wholesale project, probably a copy error); the project list technologies are used.
projects.description: Billing system rewrite for the hospital district. As a lead developer, Petri's duties involved software development, code reviewing and planning of feature implementations.

projects.name: B2B web-shop development
projects.description: B2B web-shop development, backend and frontend. Integrations to ERP and other external systems. Petri was involved in the project from the very beginning as a backend developer, initially as the sole backend developer. He wrote a large part of the backend code, assisted and guided team members, conducted code reviews, did production troubleshooting, and also contributed to frontend development. The first version had a very tight schedule, requiring production readiness within six months.
